title: Healthy Blueberry Yogurt Milkshake
excerpt: Enjoy a super creamy healthy blueberry yogurt milkshake, natural, refreshing, and perfect to share at snack time or for breakfast.
imageAlt: Tall glass with a creamy blueberry yogurt milkshake, garnished with fresh blueberries on top and a straw.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup cold milk (dairy or plant-based drink)

steps: Get your ingredients ready. If you are looking for the traditional thick texture of a milkshake, you can freeze the blueberries for two hours before preparing.
Add the Greek yogurt, cold milk, vanilla extract, and honey into the blender jar.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the cold mountains of Guasca to ensure that perfect natural sweetness, along with the ice cubes.
Blend at high speed for one minute or until achieving a silky, homogeneous, and creamy consistency.
Serve immediately in chilled tall glasses and enjoy instantly with a straw.
tips: To keep your Fresh Pick blueberries in perfect condition inside the refrigerator, store them in their original packaging without washing them; rinse them with water only right before using them.
If you prefer an even thicker milkshake without diluting the flavor with ice, freeze the yogurt beforehand in an ice cube tray and add it directly to the blender.
